confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'This points strongly to the heater element developing an internal leak to earth' - hedged, and engineer check is advised

rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to stop using the machine and stop resetting the RCD, and escalated to an engineer without recommending a part. It identified the element as the likely cause, with only moderate hedging, and did not mention that an insulation test is needed to confirm. It repeated the stop-use banner and text almost word for word, asked only one question, and never asked about the model number, whether the fault also trips another circuit, or any leaks. The customer's earlier mention of the machine tripping the RCD was acknowledged, but the second turn offered little new beyond restating the diagnosis.
